Maynooth University welcomes students from our partner universities all over the world to spend a semester or a full academic year at Maynooth University under the Erasmus+/Arqus Alliance and Non-EU exchange programmes. As a visiting student at Maynooth, you will enjoy a wonderful and unique Maynooth experience, with top quality teaching and learning facilities, friendly staff, a beautiful campus, and fun social life. network.stated_total_quote: Under the Erasmus+ Programme, Maynooth University has developed exchange partnerships with over 100 European higher education institutions in Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Türkiye and Ukraine.
